changelog:
Initial release of Etsy Seller Optimization Skill.

- Provides actionable guidance on listing SEO, tag selection, pricing strategy, shop audits, and competitor analysis.
- Encodes Etsy-specific best practices, including 2026 algorithm insights, optimal tagging, and title rules.
- Includes detailed audit and competitor analysis checklists, description templates, and a list of common Etsy mistakes.
- References popular Etsy seller tools and calculates up-to-date fee structures.
summary: Etsy shop optimization assistant. Listing SEO, tag selection, pricing strategy, competitor analysis, and shop audits. Encodes Etsy-specific domain expertise that generic AI can't replicate.
